key: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Three-phase, Two-level)
title: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Three-phase, Two-level)
text: Generate three-phase, two-level gating time information, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {PWM mode} sets the pulse width modulation method Continuous, {Continuous PWM} sets the continuous pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector, {Discontinuous PWM (DPWM)} sets the clamping method 60 DPWM: 60 degree discontinuous and {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate 1e3. Values come from the instance.

params.name: PWM mode
params.values: Pulse width modulation method Continuous PWM (CPWM) (default) | Discontinuous PWM (DPWM)

params.name: Continuous PWM
params.values: Continuous pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector modulation (default) | SPWM: sinusoidal PWM

params.name: Discontinuous PWM (DPWM)
params.values: Clamping method 60 DPWM: 60 degree discontinuous PWM (default) |...
